project_name: LATECME - Sistema de Controle de Manufatura

target_audience.primary_persona: Manufacturing operations staff at additive manufacturing facilities working with metallic powder materials (operators, inventory managers, quality inspectors)
secondary_personas: Production managers planning and monitoring manufacturing orders
Quality assurance personnel tracking material certifications
Plant administrators configuring system and managing users
pain_points: Difficulty tracking metallic powder inventory across multiple warehouses and bins
Manual or paper-based material traceability lacking audit trails
No clear visibility into material composition and certifications
Complex batch tracking for additive manufacturing processes
Inefficient purchase request and approval workflows
Lack of barcode/label generation for physical material tracking
goals: Complete traceability of metallic materials from receipt to production
Real-time inventory visibility with low-stock alerts
Streamlined purchasing workflow with approval controls
Quality control through certificate and batch tracking
Reduce manual data entry through barcode scanning
target_audience.usage_context: Daily use in manufacturing facility environments - warehouse floors for receiving and stock movements, production areas for batch preparation and material collection, offices for planning, purchasing, and reporting

product_vision.one_liner: A comprehensive inventory and production control system for additive manufacturing facilities working with metallic materials
product_vision.problem_statement: Additive manufacturing facilities using metallic powders (Aluminum, Titanium, Stainless Steel, Inconel, Cobalt-Chrome) need precise traceability, inventory control, and batch management to ensure quality, compliance, and operational efficiency - traditional inventory systems don't address the specific needs of powder metallurgy workflows
product_vision.value_proposition: Purpose-built for metallic additive manufacturing with specialized features like chemical composition tracking, powder bin management, batch preparation workflows, supplier certification tracking, and EPL barcode label generation - all integrated in a single system rather than cobbled-together general-purpose tools
success_metrics: Reduction in material waste through better inventory visibility
100% traceability from raw material receipt to finished batch
Reduced stockouts through proactive low-stock alerts

existing_features: Material catalog with chemical composition tracking (elements and percentages)
Multi-warehouse inventory management with location codes
Stock movements (IN, OUT, TRANSFER, ADJUSTMENT, RETURN, LOSS)
Supplier management with pricing, lead times, and availability
Production order management with status workflow
Batch preparation - collecting material from multiple bins
Purchase request workflow with approval process
EPL label template system for thermal printers
Network printer configuration and print job tracking
Custom user model with role-based access (Operator, Admin, Buyer)
known_gaps: Limited automated testing (only 4 test files found)
No document/certificate file upload system visible
No email notifications or alerts system
No integration with external ERP/accounting systems
technical_debt: MyPy type checking configured but in lenient mode
Some migration files may need cleanup after rapid development

differentiators: Purpose-built for additive manufacturing with metallic powders
Chemical composition tracking at element level
Bin/container management specific to powder handling
Batch preparation workflow for AM production
Integrated EPL label printing for thermal printers
competitive_context.market_position: Niche specialized solution for the additive manufacturing industry in Brazil, filling a gap between expensive enterprise ERP systems and inadequate general-purpose inventory tools

technical: Network thermal printers required for label functionality
resources: Single developer project (based on git history)
Active development with auto-claude automation assistance
